info.name: Django SAM Healthcare — Interoperability SME Demo
info.description:
Complete API collection for the healthcare integration portfolio.

## Quick Start
1. Set `base_url` to https://django-sam-healthcare.vercel.app (or http://localhost:8000)
2. Run **00 Setup / Step 1 – Get CSRF Token** then **Step 2 – Login** to establish a session.
3. For the SMART on FHIR OAuth2 flow see folder 02.
4. For Mirth webhook testing the JWT is auto-generated via pre-request script.

## Demo credentials
- Username: demo
- Password: demo1234

## Auth model
| Endpoint group | Auth method |
|---|---|
| FHIR R4, Bulk, Trace, ADT, CCDA | Django session cookie (login first) |
| Da Vinci CRD / PAS, HL7 transform | Session or BasicAuth |
| POST /api/mirth/hl7/ | Bearer JWT (HS256, auto-generated) |
| POST /oauth2/token, introspect, revoke | No auth required (open endpoints) |
| GET /.well-known/* | Public |

item.name: 01 – SMART on FHIR Discovery
item.description: Public discovery endpoints. No auth required. These are the first calls a SMART app makes.

request.description:
Returns SMART on FHIR OAuth2 server metadata. ONC-required endpoint for every certified EHR.

Expected: authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, scopes_supported, capabilities.

Returns the JSON Web Key Set. Resource servers use this to verify access token signatures.

Demo uses HS256 symmetric key. Production would use RS256/ES256 asymmetric keys.
FHIR CapabilityStatement — describes server capabilities, supported resources, and operations including $export.

item.name: 02 – OAuth2 Token Management (SMART on FHIR)
item.description:
Full SMART authorization code + PKCE flow.

Step order:
1. Register Client
2. Generate PKCE pair (pre-request script)
3. Open authorize URL in browser — approve consent → copy code from redirect URL
4. Set auth_code variable, then Exchange Code for Token
5. Use access_token for FHIR requests
6. Introspect / Revoke as needed

body.raw:
{
  "client_name": "Postman SMART Demo App",
  "redirect_uris": ["https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/callback"],
  "grant_types": ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"],
  "scope": "openid launch/patient patient/*.read offline_access",
  "token_endpoint_auth_method": "none"
}

request.description:
Registers a new public OAuth2 client (no client_secret required — uses PKCE).

Return value includes client_id — save it to the collection variable.

item.name: Generate PKCE Pair (pre-request only — open authorize URL in browser)

request.description:
PKCE pair is generated in the pre-request script.

**Instructions:**
1. Send this request — the pre-request script will populate code_verifier and code_challenge variables.
2. Copy the full URL from the request tab.
3. Open it in your browser (you must be logged in to the demo app).
4. Approve the consent screen.
5. Copy the `code=` value from the redirect URL.
6. Paste it into the `auth_code` collection variable.
7. Run 'Exchange Auth Code for Token'.

exec: console.log('Now open the URL in a browser, approve consent, then copy code= from redirect URL.');
console.log('Set auth_code variable to that value, then run Exchange Auth Code for Token.');

item.name: Exchange Auth Code for Token (authorization_code + PKCE)

request.description:
Exchanges the authorization code for an access token.

PKCE S256 validation: server recomputes SHA256(code_verifier) and compares to stored code_challenge.

Response includes `patient` context — the authorized patient ID.

exec: console.log('Access token saved. Patient context:', body.patient);

request.description:
System-to-system token (no user context). Used for payer-to-payer data exchange and backend integrations.

Note: client must have client_credentials in its grant_types. Register a new client with that grant if needed.

exec: pm.test('Expected: client may not support client_credentials grant', () => {
console.log('Register a new client with grant_types=[client_credentials] to test this flow.');

request.description:
Rotates the refresh token — old token is revoked, new access + refresh tokens issued.

Reusing a rotated refresh token returns invalid_grant (security: detect replay attacks).

Resource servers call this to validate a Bearer token and retrieve metadata.

Returns active=true with scope, patient context, and expiry. Returns active=false for invalid/revoked/expired tokens.
Revokes a token immediately. Subsequent introspect calls return active=false.

exec: console.log('Token revoked. Run Introspect to confirm active=false.');

request.description: Negative test: wrong code_verifier should fail PKCE validation and return invalid_grant.

item.name: 06 – Da Vinci Prior Authorization
item.description: CMS-0057-F (2026) mandate. CDS Hooks Coverage Requirements Discovery + FHIR Prior Auth Submission.

request.description:
CPT 73721 = MRI joint — prior auth required by most plans.

Expected: CDS card with indicator=warning and documentation_needed list.

exec: pm.test('Card has summary', () => pm.expect(card.summary).to.include('Prior Authorization Required'));

item.name: POST /api/prior-auth/crd/ — Office Visit (no PA) → info card

request.description: CPT 99213 = office visit — no prior auth required.
CPT 90837 = psychotherapy — exempt from PA under mental health parity laws.

Submits PA request with complete clinical notes → should be approved.

No clinical notes → pended (additional info required).
